name: Shanghai Pioneer Holding Ltd
summary: China Pioneer Pharma Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the marketing, promotion, and distribution of pharmaceutical goods and medical devices within mainland China. The firm maintains an extensive portfolio of pharmaceutical products addressing diverse therapeutic areas, including ophthalmology, pain management, cardiovascular health, immunology, gynecology, and gastroenterology. Its medical device offerings encompass solutions for ophthalmology, orthopedics, dentistry, and wound care. The company supplies its products to a wide client base, including hospitals, various medical institutions, and pharmacies. Additionally, it engages in the sale of supporting tools, leases related equipment, provides dental apparatus, and distributes imported prescription products under license. Established in 1996, China Pioneer Pharma Holdings Limited is headquartered in Shanghai, PRC, and functions as a subsidiary of Pioneer Pharma (BVI) Co., Ltd.
